status: Superseded planning alternatives: see external-supply-selector-decision.json for resolved user direction
prior_release_preserved: hardware/octopus_external_adapter/r0_1 and frozen review archive remain unchanged
user_objective: One carefully engineered adapter supporting both3.3 V and5 V controller signals, with independent regulated power and potential12/24 V use.

accepted_targets.controller_logic: 3.3 V or5 V automatically; no12/24 V on host STEP/DIR/EN
accepted_targets.host_socket: Removable StepStick-compatible socket with confirmed pinout, orientation and mechanical clearance

pending_user_decision.decision: User requested screw-terminal external supply with 5V / EXT selector

power_architecture.recommended_input: Dedicated keyed nominal12/24 V connector, protected against reverse polarity and rated transients; omitted VM socket contact retained
power_architecture.external_5V_option: Separate protected regulated5 V power input and reverse-current-blocking source selection after buck. A reference-only source is insufficient.
power_architecture.source_mux_candidate: TPS2116DRLR, regulated low-voltage side only; never direct12/24 V
power_architecture.host_VIO: Reference/sense only; never tied directly to adapter local5 V rail
power_architecture.local_logic: 3.3 V LDO e.g.TLV75533PDBVR from regulated5 V
power_architecture.driver_control_selection: Independent from adapter supply selection.12 V input cannot produce24 V control without a separate24 V source or additional conversion.

five_volt_only.candidate: SN74LVC3G06DCUR at3.3 V, outputs with5 V common
five_volt_only.evidence: VIH2.0 V and VIL0.8 V at VCC3.0–3.6 V; sink VOL≤0.4 V at16 mA VCC3 V.
five_volt_only.qualification: Actual host logic margins and loaded driver/cable testing remain required.

five_twelve_twenty_four.candidate: SN74LVC3G17DCUR at3.3 V plus3x NX6008NBKW60 V MOSFET outputs and gate pulldowns
five_twelve_twenty_four.evidence: NX6008NBKW RDS(on) max2.9Ω at VGS2.5 V at25°C; temperature/voltage/transient qualifications remain open.
five_twelve_twenty_four.scope: Common-anode optocoupled STEP/DIR/ENA inputs; driver-specific input current, resistor/selector and timing requirements apply.
not_covered: Common-cathode-only interface without additional output topology
Boards with soldered drivers and no compatible socket

required_reviews: Input threshold margin for each named host
Driver enable polarity and startup/power sequencing
Actual pulse timing, loaded edges and no spurious steps
Reverse polarity, overvoltage, TVS/clamp coordination and source overlap
Regulator layout, effective capacitance, thermal and EMI
Mechanical fit: current15.24x20.32 mm size not yet proven for additional connectors/power parts
Factory DFM, harness procurement and prototype measurements
